events.text: Your first overnight shift in the hospital is brutal — a code blue and three admissions before dawn.

choices.label: Stay focused and learn
choices.resultText: The attending noticed your composure under pressure.

choices.label: Ask a senior for mentorship
choices.resultText: They shared tricks that textbooks never cover.

events.text: You're handed your first real courtroom argument — the client is nervous and the judge is stern.

choices.label: Deliver a sharp opening
choices.resultText: Your points landed. The client exhaled with relief.

choices.label: Settle pragmatically
choices.resultText: Both sides walked away with something — and you kept your sanity.

events.text: A social worker schedules a home visit to assess whether you're ready to adopt.

choices.label: Prepare the home thoughtfully
choices.resultText: The report was glowing. Your file moved to the top of the list.

choices.label: Wing it
choices.resultText: The visit felt awkward. You'll need to try again next year.

events.text: Your partner brings up a prenuptial agreement before the wedding planning gets serious.

choices.label: Discuss it calmly
choices.resultText: Awkward at first, but you both felt clearer about finances.

choices.label: Take it personally
choices.resultText: The conversation ended in a tense silence.

events.text: A lawyer offers to help you petition to expunge your old criminal record.

choices.label: File the petition
choices.resultText: Paperwork filed. The waiting game begins.

choices.label: Not yet
choices.resultText: You decided to wait until you had more savings.

events.text: A gossip blog publishes a rumor about your personal life. Your phone won't stop buzzing.

choices.label: Issue a calm statement
choices.resultText: The story faded faster than you feared.

choices.label: Ignore it
choices.resultText: The rumor spread anyway, but you kept your dignity.

choices.label: Lean into the attention
choices.resultText: Followers spiked. Your family was not amused.

events.text: Routine bloodwork flags something your doctor wants to discuss in person.

choices.label: Schedule follow-up tests
choices.resultText: Early detection gives you options — and a plan.

choices.label: Delay the appointment
choices.resultText: Anxiety grew while you avoided the clinic.

events.text: You pick up a part-time job after school. The manager hands you your first paycheck.

choices.label: Save most of it
choices.resultText: Your savings jar finally has real weight to it.

choices.label: Treat yourself
choices.resultText: You bought something you'd wanted for months.

events.text: You watch a home makeover show and start imagining what your place could look like.

choices.label: Sketch a renovation plan
choices.resultText: You pinned ideas for a kitchen refresh and better lighting.

choices.label: Drop the idea
choices.resultText: Maybe next year when cash flow is easier.

events.text: Financial headlines debate whether investors should play it safe or chase growth this year.

choices.label: Rebalance toward safety
choices.resultText: You slept better after dialing back risk.

choices.label: Stay the course
choices.resultText: Markets move in cycles. You kept your plan.

events.text: During clinical rotations you comfort a frightened patient before a procedure.

choices.label: Hold their hand and explain
choices.resultText: The charge nurse thanked you for your bedside manner.

choices.label: Focus on vitals only
choices.resultText: You nailed the charting even if the moment felt cold.

events.text: Your engineering capstone team demo crashes twice before the presentation.

choices.label: Debug all night
choices.resultText: The prototype worked on the third try. The panel applauded.

choices.label: Present the theory instead
choices.resultText: You salvaged the grade with a strong slide deck.

events.text: A local firm offers you a summer internship in their business development team.

choices.label: Accept eagerly
choices.resultText: You learned more in eight weeks than a semester of lectures.

choices.label: Decline to focus on exams
choices.resultText: Your GPA thanked you, but your network didn't grow.

events.text: After release, a community center hosts a workshop on clearing your record and finding work.

choices.label: Attend and take notes
choices.resultText: You left with a checklist and a little hope.

choices.label: Skip it
choices.resultText: Old habits felt easier than paperwork.

events.text: Tenants ask for upgraded fixtures after you renovated the kitchen.

choices.label: Invest in better appliances
choices.resultText: Rent reviews went smoothly and tenants renewed.

choices.label: Keep rent as-is
choices.resultText: One tenant gave notice at lease end.
